title: ☄️ Quadrantids Meteor Shower — Peak Night
description:
The Quadrantids meteor shower reaches its peak tonight, produced by debris left behind by Asteroid 2003 EH1 as Earth passes through its orbital trail.

Under ideal dark-sky conditions, observers can expect up to 120 meteors per hour (ZHR). Meteors radiate from the constellation Boötes but can appear anywhere in the sky. No equipment needed — just a dark location, a reclining chair, and patience. The best viewing is typically after midnight when the radiant is highest.
